description: A complete DATA C_PDU held by the DTS for in-order delivery ends the Called node's first-data wait before it is delivered; a segment of an incomplete C_PDU does not.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ at 0. As cas/make-called-accept up to 57550: 0.0.1.3 calls, this node accepts, and the link is made with this node as the Called node when the accept's transmission ends (B-0213, B-0400, C-1100): link_state linked, cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 with cas.first_data_timeout_ms (B-0215, B-0216) and the called node's soft link timers (A-0194). The Caller sends two in-order C_PDUs: A, a DATA C_PDU carrying "aaaa" in FSN 0, and B, a DATA C_PDU carrying "bbbbbbbb", 14 octets cut into FSN 1 (C_PDU START, 7 octets) and FSN 2 (C_PDU END, 7 octets), all with DELIVER IN ORDER, TTD and SAP as A. FSN 0 is lost in the Caller's first transmission. At 61000 DATA-ONLY FSN 1 arrives (TX WIN UWE, EOT 20). It is stored and owes an acknowledgement (C-0174), but B is not complete, so nothing is delivered or held, and cas.first_data keeps running: a segment of an incomplete C_PDU is not a DATA C_PDU received (B-0403, issue #77). The burst ends at 62000 with the EOT end at 71000: csma.vdcd_end 9000, LBT rule 1 (K-0067), contention 12000 ms, and at 83000 our ACK-ONLY: RX LWE 0, Ack Data 01, the bit for FSN 1 (C-0201, C-0207). At 101000 DATA-ONLY FSN 2 arrives (FSN 0 lost again). B is now complete, but FSN 0 is still missing, so B is held for in-order delivery (C-0178, C-1123) and nothing goes to the SIS. B has been received though, so the first-data wait ends: cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 is cancelled here, before B is delivered (B-0215, B-0403, B-0460). Burst end 102000, csma.vdcd_end 9000, contention 45000 ms, and at 156000 the ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 0 and Ack Data 03 (FSN 1 and 2). At 171000 FSN 0 arrives: A is complete and nothing is missing before it, so A is delivered, then B, in FSN order (C-0178, C-1123); the idle wait restarts on each ARQ C_PDU received (A-0320). Burst end 172000, csma.vdcd_end 9000, contention 36000 ms, and at 217000 the ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 3 and no Ack Data. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20 for 1, 2 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly, C_PDU IDs from 0 (C-1040), EOW 0. Settings: cas.max_links, cas.link_request_timeout_ms 60000, cas.link_request_retries and cas.first_data_timeout_ms 120000. The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived from the answer wait (A-0321).
